notes.title: Pre-Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey guys,



A Court of Chaos is set to fully release in October!



I've been working hard behind the scenes to make sure the game is hot, heavy, and with as little fluff as possible!



Unfortunately I've had to cut back on certain scenes to help ensure the game complies with Steam's new policy regarding NSFW games. I can only apologise for this, but hopefully we can bring it back with DLC or a future update (it might be better to risk DLC being taken down rather than the whole game). Time will tell how this all blows over.



The game will release with 5 achievements, two different endings, and two women at your behest! There are optional scenes in game where you can choose to humiliate the queen at the service of another man (however this is completely preventable, not just avoidable).



Thanks for following the game, I hope you'll enjoy it!

-The Sexy Chinaman
